name: codex-tags
description: Add tag-aware session browsing and local content search to the Codex desktop sidebar.

interface.shortDescription: Tag, filter, and search local Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Codex Tags installs a reversible local enhancement for the official Codex desktop app. It renders structured session tags, provides a searchable Tags dashboard, and keeps session content on the local machine.
defaultPrompt: Install or update the Codex Tags sidebar enhancement.
Check whether Codex Tags is running correctly.
